summary.text: Timmy Guerrette is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 4 since December 6, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A firefighter and paramedic from Caribou, he is the only candidate listed for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Timmy Guerrette lives in Caribou, Maine.
His career experience includes working as a firefighter and paramedic with the Caribou Fire & Ambulance Department.
He was assigned to the Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Committee in 2023-2024 and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
